selection.quote: "Electric scooter" means a device with handlebars and an electric motor that is designed to be ridden on in an upright or seated position and propelled by its electric motor or by propulsion provided by the rider.
selection.reason: The definition denotes a set of tracked ridden devices whose eligibility can be classified by the road-user classes.

Such a device must not weigh more than one hundred pounds without a rider and must have a maximum speed of not more than twenty miles per hour when powered solely by its electric motor.

classifications.reason: A bicycle with an assisting electric motor can meet the admitting words, but the words neither admit nor exclude bicycles as such and the weight and speed limits are not carried by the class contract.
